  "categories": [

      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies package validation and replacement evaluation logic in src/validation.cpp and src/rpc/mempool.cpp to support package feerate aggregation and RBF checks during dry runs.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables wallets to dry-run 1p1c package acceptance and replacement checks without mutating the mempool. The PR partially resolves issue #32160 by enabling pre-flight evaluation of CPFP fee bumps and sibling eviction, satisfying a clear downstream use case for L2/wallets while remaining reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds the testsubmitpackage JSON-RPC method in src/rpc/mempool.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Fills an interface gap that prevented wallet and LND developers from pre-flight testing package transactions without polluting the mempool. Downstream software has explicitly requested this functionality (citing issue #32160 and LND batch preparation), meeting the category priority for missing methods with documented external demand."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The functional test and runner additions specifically pin the new RPC rather than altering shared test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Excluded because tests of a specific RPC method belong to that feature's area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/validation.cpp affect mempool dry-run package acceptance rather than consensus or chainstate validity rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Excluded by definition: PRs whose primary subject is mempool policy belong to mempool even when they touch validation files."
    }
